item.title: Claude safety evals and tool-use system card
item.description:
Anthropic publishes a model release system card for Claude that explains benchmark evals, capability boundaries, and safety constraints.

The opening preview includes containment, deployment constraints, tool use permissions, regression checks, and observability for production agents.
